top_signals.title: Treasuries Slide After Middle East Strife Report Spurs Oil Gains
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fell after reports suggesting the Middle East war is heating up lifted oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Earnings Fuel AI Bets; Oil Whipsaws: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A blockbuster earnings report from SpaceX spurred a rally in technology stocks, easing concerns over whether a global investment spree in artificial intelligence can prove sustainable.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Small Business Owners Remain Optimistic, Says Chase for Business CEO
top_signals.summary: Stevie Baron, CEO of Chase for Business, said that despite a difficult geoeconomic landscape, small business owners remain optimistic about their individual business and their potential for success across industries. Speaking from the Chase Make Your Move Summit in Atlanta, Baron said that Chase's aim is to support small business owners and do whatever it can as a bank to make owners financial lives easier.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Education ministry calls for University of Tokyo to review president selection
top_signals.summary: It is the first time the government has requested a review of how a university selected its president.
